title: Fast from retaliation
summary: The fearless Yogi sees the Lord among trees, home, and open places. Retaliation loses force when the One being remembered is already everywhere.
takeaway: Fast from retaliation because the Fearless One is already present.
lifeApplication: Before answering from the wound, look for the Lord in the room, the doorway, and the person in front of you. Let that presence make retaliation feel too small to serve.

source.shortMeaning: The fearless one meditates on the Immaculate Lord who is present inside, outside, and among all places.
source.lifeApplication: When resentment rises, answer first from the Lord’s nearness instead of retaliation.

evidence.coreClaim: The fearless one meditates on the Immaculate Lord who is present inside, outside, and among all places.
evidence.turn: Forgiveness becomes possible because the Lord is not absent from the place where fear tries to rule.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before answering from the wound, look for the Lord in the room, the doorway, and the person in front of you. Let that presence make retaliation feel too small to serve.
